text.p: -- Santander Investment said it has downgraded its rating on shares of Brazilian white goods and portable appliance producer Electrolux do Brasil, formally known as Refripar, to market perform from buy.
-- The bank cited increasing competition in the sector and a slowdown in the growth of sales and earnings for Electrolux, a unit of Electrolux AB.
-- Nonetheless, it revised upwards its previous estimates of Electrolux earnings per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) for 1997, 1998 and 1999.
-- "Electrolux's majority shareholder, AB Electrolux recently boosted its stake in the Brazilian white goods producer to near 51 percent," Santander said in a report.
-- "With the merger of Embel, Oberdorfer and Electrolux do Brasil into Electrolux, the company offers the most complete product line in Brazil."

-- But it said it expects annual sales and earnings growth rates in the 1997-99 period to slow to between 7.1 percent and 4.5 percent from between 67.5 percent and 41.7 percent in the prior three-year period.
-- It raised its EPS estimate to $2.14 from $1.20 for 1997, to $1.84 from $1.40 for 1998 and to $11.76 from $1.70 for 1999.
-- Santander also set a 12-month target price of $10.75 per ADR, a rise of roughly 12 percent from curent levels but slightly below the outlook for the Sao Paulo bolsa.
-- Electrolux common was untraded today in Sao Paulo and closed April 25 at 2 reais. Its preferred stock was down 1.96 percent at 2 reais.
